description: Renovate manages npm here; Dependabot keeps github-actions and docker.
Both bots would otherwise open a pull request for the same update, and
every duplicate costs a bumptriage review. Splitting by ecosystem also
means both bot profiles get exercised against the real action.
Branch prefix is left at the default `renovate/`, which is what the
review workflow and the action's bot profiles match on.
The agent SDK is the one dependency whose update genuinely changes
behaviour, so it is never batched with anything else.
